events.title: The First Patch for the Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes Demo Is Here
events.summary: Hello, friends!A little imp in the code led us slightly astray, but everything is back in order now. We’ve released a new version of the Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes demo, and we hope you’ll enjoy it.You can find the full list of changes and improvements below at the end of this update.Thank you so much for being with us on this journey.Version 0.6.5Change: The hero starts with 8 experience points instead of 10.Fix: Added the missing effect when harvesting night flowers in the pastures.
